cause: 415c57d limited the pull_request trigger to main, so PRs into develop never started the workflow whose five jobs develop's protection requires
expected: a PR into develop runs the CI jobs develop's protection requires, so it merges on green with no bypass
repro: gh pr view 33 --json mergeStateStatus -> BLOCKED; gh pr checks 33 -> GitGuardian only; develop branch protection lists 5 required CI contexts; .github/workflows/ci.yml pull_request.branches: [main]
solution: Add develop to pull_request.branches; push trigger unchanged. RED proof is the live PR: before, only GitGuardian; after, the five checks.
symptom: develop's branch protection requires CI / Lint and type-check, Build, Unit tests, E2E and Lighthouse, but ci.yml (lines 6-13) triggers pull_request only for branches [main]; a PR into develop (PR #33) gets none of them and is BLOCKED (mergeStateStatus BLOCKED, only GitGuardian ran).
title: CI never runs the checks develop's branch protection requires
